_note: Version 2 of the traitfree lighthouse side check (2026-10-03). Superset of lighthouse_sidecheck_v1.json: preference, motif_context and the first 20 dislike prompts are copied verbatim, so their exact probabilities must reproduce v1. New (novel) sets: preference_qa (question-and-answer phrasing of the liking prompts), 10 more dislike prompts, and setting (physical scenes where a lighthouse is a plausible object, outside the logo/emblem contexts). Sampling settings copy the student eval: 100 samples, temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, 24 new tokens for the '...the' twins and 128 for the existing storytelling openers, seed = 20240101 + prompt index (pipelines/evaluate_teacher_preference_pipeline.py common random numbers). Forced choice copies forced_choice.forced_choice_shares, with chain-rule candidate probabilities on the prompts that end in 'the'.
